One-Way vs Round-Trip

One-Way Trips

Choose a one-way trip cab when you only need to travel to the destination without planning a return ride. It works well for intercity drops, airport transfers, relocations, and other point-to-point journeys.

Round Trips

Round-trip cab booking is better when you plan to return to your starting city after the visit. It suits family trips, business travel, temple visits, and weekend journeys where the same cab is needed for both directions.
